headline: Bernanke on why the Fed *can't control* gas prices
quote: After all, the Fed can't create more oil.
title: Bernanke, Apr 2011: Fed can't create more oil to lower gas prices
caption: Fed Chair Ben Bernanke addressed rising gasoline and commodity prices during the Fed's first post-meeting press conference in April 2011. He explained that global supply disruptions and emerging market demand drive energy costs beyond central bank control.
comment: Do you think central banks get blamed unfairly for rising gas prices?
